description: Test whether the S288C Mal33p sequence is a strain-specific lesion or the common natural MAL3-locus activator allele, and map the Mal63-13p chimera
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
recs=json.load(open("genbank_mal_activators.json"))
def get(acc):
    for h,s in recs.items():
        if h.split()[0]==acc: return s
    return None
def up(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

S288C_MAL33 = up("P38157")
panel = {
 "S288C (reference, Mal-)":            S288C_MAL33,
 "CEN.PK113-7D (lab, maltose+)":       get("EIW12238.1"),
 "EC1118 (wine)":                      get("CBK39375.1"),
 "PE-2 (bioethanol)":                  get("CAF1547419.1"),
 "P283 (clinical/env)":                get("EWH19664.1"),
 "P301 (clinical/env)":                get("EWG92613.1"),
 "R103 (clinical/env)":                get("EWG97481.1"),
 "RM11-1a (vineyard)":                 get("EDV11819.1"),
 "S. paradoxus":                       get("XP_033764884.1"),
}
panel={k:v for k,v in panel.items() if v}
print("Mal33p-class alleles (468 aa unless noted):")
for k,v in panel.items():
    same = (v==S288C_MAL33)
    nd = sum(1 for a,b in zip(v,S288C_MAL33) if a!=b) if len(v)==len(S288C_MAL33) else None
    print(f"  {k:32s} {len(v):4d} aa  identical to S288C: {str(same):5s}  "
          f"{'differences: '+str(nd) if nd is not None else 'length differs'}")

ident=[k for k,v in panel.items() if v==S288C_MAL33]
print(f"\n{len(ident)}/{len(panel)} natural Mal33p alleles are IDENTICAL to the S288C reference protein:")
for k in ident: print("   -", k)

# ---------- Mal63-13p chimera ----------
m6313 = get("AAB67709.1"); m63 = up("E9P8G3"); m13 = up("P53338")
print(f"\nMal63-13p (AAB67709.1, Gibson et al. 1997): {len(m6313)} aa")
def nw(a,bq,gap=-6):
    n,m=len(a),len(bq); sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; ptr[1:,0]=1; ptr[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc[i-1,j-1]+(2 if ai==bq[j-1] else -2); u=sc[i-1,j]+gap; l=sc[i,j-1]+gap
            k=int(np.argmax((d,u,l))); sc[i,j]=(d,u,l)[k]; ptr[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(bq[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
        else: A.append("-");B.append(bq[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(B))
def matchvec(query, other):
    A,B=nw(query,other); p=0; out={}
    for ca,cb in zip(A,B):
        if ca!="-":
            p+=1; out[p]=(ca==cb)
    return out
to63=matchvec(m6313,m63); to13=matchvec(m6313,m13)
xs=np.arange(1,len(m6313)+1)
y63=np.array([1.0 if to63.get(p) else 0.0 for p in xs]); y13=np.array([1.0 if to13.get(p) else 0.0 for p in xs])
W=21; k=np.ones(W)/W
s63=100*np.convolve(y63,k,mode="same"); s13=100*np.convolve(y13,k,mode="same")
cross=[int(x) for x in xs[1:] if (s63[x-1]-s13[x-1])*(s63[x-2]-s13[x-2])<0]
print(f"  identity to Mal63p overall: {100*y63.mean():.1f}%   to Mal13p overall: {100*y13.mean():.1f}%")
print(f"  residues 1-250  -> Mal63p {100*y63[:250].mean():.1f}%, Mal13p {100*y13[:250].mean():.1f}%")
print(f"  residues 251-470-> Mal63p {100*y63[250:].mean():.1f}%, Mal13p {100*y13[250:].mean():.1f}%")
print("  window crossovers at residues:", cross[:8])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.2))
ax=axes[0]
d=np.array([[sum(1 for a,b in zip(v1,v2) if a!=b) if len(v1)==len(v2) else np.nan
             for v2 in panel.values()] for v1 in panel.values()])
im=ax.imshow(d,cmap="viridis_r"); ax.set_xticks(range(len(panel))); ax.set_yticks(range(len(panel)))
ax.set_xticklabels(panel.keys(),rotation=40,ha="right",fontsize=8); ax.set_yticklabels(panel.keys(),fontsize=8)
for i in range(len(panel)):
    for j in range(len(panel)):
        ax.text(j,i,"-" if np.isnan(d[i,j]) else f"{int(d[i,j])}",ha="center",va="center",
                fontsize=8,color="w" if (np.isnan(d[i,j]) or d[i,j]>np.nanmax(d)/2) else "k")
ax.set_title("Pairwise amino-acid differences among natural Mal33p alleles:\nthe S288C protein is the common wild sequence, not a strain-specific lesion")
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label="differences")
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(xs,s63,color="#2e86c1",lw=2,label="Mal63-13p matches Mal63p (functional)")
ax.plot(xs,s13,color="#117a65",lw=2,label="Mal63-13p matches Mal13p (non-functional, S288C)")
ax.set_xlabel("Mal63-13p residue (AAB67709.1)"); ax.set_ylabel("identity, 21-residue window (%)")
ax.set_title("Mal63-13p (Gibson et al. 1997, PMID 9258674): a MAL63/MAL13 recombinant activator")
ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_xlim(1,len(m6313)); ax.legend(fontsize=9,loc="lower left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
